title: The finite strict completed Koszul tensor augmentation
statement: For the actual completed coefficient datum and fixed reconstruction models [def-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction-models], let a finite list a generate I. The strict Koszul total tensor tower functor, transposed to complexes of towers, admits a unique natural transformation beta to the ordinary strict quotient tensor tower. For every complex P and positive quotient level n+1 its composite with the actual Koszul tensor unit equals the ordinary quotient tensor unit. Its component vanishes on each total summand with nonzero exterior degree. There is no K-flatness condition and no derived-limit assertion. The source tower and all total summand injections are explicit constructions from the fixed models.

theorem completedKoszulTensorQuotientAugmentation
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal) :
    ∃! β : completedKoszulTensorTower T d r a ⟶
        (completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        completedAdicKoszulTensorUnit T d r a P n ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map (β.app P)).app (op n) =
            completedQuotientTensorUnit T d P n) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0),
        completedKoszulTensorSummand T d r a P n p q ≫
            ((HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
              (β.app P)).app (op n)).f (p + q) = 0)
